versions.notes: In-app self-update: old app detects new version (start/resume/6h/refresh), 'Update now' downloads the APK inside the app with a progress bar, then opens the Android installer (falls back to browser download on old builds). Requires Android 'install unknown apps' permission.

Bookings ops (approve/reject/check-in/cancel, deposit verify+redeem), promo/coupon, sessions move/swap, inventory stock-out/check/alerts, report+balances, attendance check-out, gift card, rank/bonus, notification centre, 80mm printing. English UI.
